item.name: Calculate an optimized route between a known start and end point.

request.name: Calculate an optimized route between a known start and end point.

description.content: The optimized route API is a mix of the matrix and normal route API. For an optimized route, the start and end point are fixed, but the intermediate points will be re-ordered to form an optimal route visiting all nodes once.

response.name: The optimized route, which looks more or less like a normal route response. The only significant difference is that the `locations` may be re-ordered and annotated with an `original_index`.
